mapper.select: select from drive_space where space_id = #{spaceId} for update

select from drive_space where space_type = 'DEPARTMENT'
and dept_id in
#{deptId}
and 1 = 0
order by dept_id
select from drive_space where space_type = #{spaceType} order by space_id
mapper.insert: insert ignore into drive_space ( space_key, space_type, owner_user_id, dept_id, space_name, quota_bytes, used_bytes, quota_source_type, quota_source_id, quota_synced_time, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark ) values ( #{spaceKey}, #{spaceType}, #{ownerUserId}, #{deptId}, #{spaceName}, #{quotaBytes}, #{usedBytes}, #{quotaSourceType}, #{quotaSourceId}, #{quotaSyncedTime}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: update drive_space set used_bytes = used_bytes + #{bytes}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where space_id = #{spaceId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and used_bytes + #{bytes} <= quota_bytes
update drive_space set used_bytes = used_bytes - #{bytes}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where space_id = #{spaceId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and used_bytes >= #{bytes}

update drive_space set quota_bytes = #{quotaBytes}, quota_source_type = #{quotaSourceType}, quota_source_id = #{quotaSourceId}, quota_synced_time = now(), version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where space_id = #{spaceId} and version = #{version} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'READ_ONLY')

update drive_space set space_name = #{spaceName}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where space_type = 'DEPARTMENT' and dept_id = #{deptId} and (space_name <> #{spaceName} or status <> #{status})
